sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi không thể ngủ được vì quá ồn ào explains a limit without making the exchange tense. It helps someone understand I cannot sleep because it is too noisy and offer a simpler option, a written detail, or a next step.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Tôi không thể ngủ được vì quá ồn ào calmly and show the proof if you have it: booking screen, room key, address, room number, or photo of the issue. After that, let the other person ask one follow-up or point you to the right next step.
